text.p: Unisource Worldwide Inc said Tuesday that absent a significant improvement in paper pricing, it expects fiscal 1997 earnings per share to be 30 to 35 percent below 1996 pro forma levels.
The company's net income was $60 million in the fiscal year ended September 30, 1996, which included a $50 million pre-tax restructuring charge. A per share amount was not immediately available.
Unisource reported first quarter earnings of $0.45 a share, compared to pro forma $0.76 a share, which adjusts for its spin-off.
The company said that paper prices for the quarter were down 12 percent from the same period last year.
The company also said that it is reviewing expenses at every level.
